about: Saint-Félicien is a city at the western end of Lac Saint-Jean in the Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean region of Quebec. A forestry and service town, it is widely known for the Zoo sauvage de Saint-Félicien and as a gateway to the Ashuapmushuan country. About 10,000 people live in Saint-Félicien.
seoSummary: Lac Saint-Jean city known for the Zoo sauvage and western-lake forestry-and-service role.
